mapper.select:
SELECT like_data.likeId, like_data.resourceType, like_data.resourceId, like_data.publicId, like_data.channelCode, like_data.title, like_data.coverUrl, like_data.avatarUrl, like_data.sceneImageUrl, like_data.authorName, like_data.authorAvatar, like_data.likedAt FROM (
SELECT l.id AS likeId, l.resource_type AS resourceType, l.resource_id AS resourceId, rp.id AS publicId, rp.channel_code AS channelCode, COALESCE(NULLIF(rp.display_title, ''), r.role_name) AS title, COALESCE(NULLIF(rp.cover_image_url, ''), r.cover_url) AS coverUrl, r.avatar_url AS avatarUrl, NULL AS sceneImageUrl, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.realname, ''), u.username) AS authorName, u.avatar AS authorAvatar, l.created_at AS likedAt FROM ts_user_resource_like l INNER JOIN ts_role_info r ON r.id = l.resource_id INNER JOIN ts_role_public rp ON rp.id = ( SELECT rp2.id FROM ts_role_public rp2 WHERE rp2.role_id = r.id AND rp2.status = 'online' ORDER BY rp2.sort_order ASC, rp2.published_at DESC, rp2.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = r.user_id WHERE l.user_id = #{query.userId} AND l.resource_type = 'role' AND l.status = 1 AND (r.status IS NULL OR r.status != 0)
AND ( r.role_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR rp.display_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') )
UNION ALL
SELECT l.id AS likeId, l.resource_type AS resourceType, l.resource_id AS resourceId, sp.id AS publicId, sp.channel_code AS channelCode, COALESCE(NULLIF(sp.display_title, ''), s.title) AS title, COALESCE(NULLIF(sp.cover_image_url, ''), s.cover_url) AS coverUrl, NULL AS avatarUrl, s.scene_image_url AS sceneImageUrl, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.realname, ''), u.username) AS authorName, u.avatar AS authorAvatar, l.created_at AS likedAt FROM ts_user_resource_like l INNER JOIN ts_story_info s ON s.id = l.resource_id INNER JOIN ts_story_public sp ON sp.id = ( SELECT sp2.id FROM ts_story_public sp2 WHERE sp2.story_id = s.id AND sp2.status = 'online' ORDER BY sp2.sort_order ASC, sp2.published_at DESC, sp2.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = s.user_id WHERE l.user_id = #{query.userId} AND l.resource_type = 'story' AND l.status = 1 AND s.is_deleted = 0 AND (s.status IS NULL OR s.status != 9)
AND ( s.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR s.story_intro LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR sp.display_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') )
) like_data ORDER BY like_data.likedAt DESC, like_data.likeId DESC

choose.when: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ts_role_info r INNER JOIN ts_role_public rp ON rp.role_id = r.id AND rp.status = 'online' WHERE r.id = #{resourceId} AND (r.status IS NULL OR r.status != 0)
choose.otherwise: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ts_story_info s INNER JOIN ts_story_public sp ON sp.story_id = s.id AND sp.status = 'online' WHERE s.id = #{resourceId} AND s.is_deleted = 0 AND (s.status IS NULL OR s.status != 9)

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ts_user_resource_like ( user_id, resource_type, resource_id, status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{resourceType}, #{resourceId}, 1, #{now}, #{now} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE created_at = IF(status = 0, VALUES(created_at), created_at), updated_at = IF(status = 0, VALUES(updated_at), updated_at), status = 1
